service.description: What a user (the current user; another only with authorization disabled) may do in a room. level: 0 none, 1 read (a public room, or a record room whose record the user may see, without being a member), 2 member, 3 moderator, 4 owner. canRead, canJoin (not a member and may join; not archived), canPost (a member of a room that is not archived), canModerate (level 3 and up in a room that is not direct), isOwner. room is the room as find#Rooms lists it (null when not found or not readable); member the user's member row (null when none). Adds no error for a room the user cannot reach, so a caller may use it as a check.

Whether the current user may see a record, so they may read and join the room bound to it: the service the user's qapps theme names in STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE (found as the shell counts service is) is called as the user, with the caller's authorization and entity filters, with recordEntityName, recordId and checkOnly true, and answers recordVisible. No such theme value: false (only members reach record rooms), logged once. A service that fails or answers no recordVisible: false, logged once. Adds no error.

Internal: send message to the users of userIdList on a chat topic (chatRoom:id, chatUser:userId or userStatus) as a NotificationMessage that is not persisted and shows no alert; after the caller's transaction commits (nothing on a rollback), and at once outside one.

Internal: add an event to a room's timeline with the room's next eventSeq, and push it to the room's members on chatRoom:id (unless noPush). The caller has checked access. A message of the main timeline (no threadRootEventSeq) becomes the room's last message. event is the event as pushed: get#Timeline's shape without the aggregates. memberUserIdList are the users it was pushed to.
Internal: send these users their shell counts after their chat counts changed. Failure tolerant: an error is logged, not returned.

actions.script: const users = Array.from(new Set((userIdList || []).filter((id) => id))) if (!users.length) return ec.message.pushErrors() ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ShellServices.publish#ShellCounts').parameter('userIdList', users).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) ec.logger.warn(`Could not publish the shell counts of ${users.join(', ')}: ${ec.message.errorsString}`) ec.message.clearErrors() ec.message.popErrors()

service.description: Internal: put a message in the search index (the MoquiChatEvent document), or take it out (remove, or a message that is redacted). Nothing without search. Failure tolerant: an error is logged.

The current user's rooms (another user's only with authorization disabled), pinned first, then by the last event. Each: the room's fields, displayName (a direct room's: the other members' names), isMember, my roleEnumId, notificationLevelEnumId, isPinned, isMuted, lastReadEventSeq, unreadCount (messages from others after my read marker), mentionCount, lastMessage {eventSeq, senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, snippet}, and for a direct room otherUserIdList and, with one other member, otherUserId and presence (as get#UserStatuses gives it). filter: unread (unread messages or mentions), mentions, direct, rooms (private and public), records; searchText matches the name and topic. includeJoinable adds the public rooms the user has not joined (isMember false). unreadTotal and mentionTotal add up the listed rooms.

A room the user may read, with its members (current ones; memberList each {userId, name, roleEnumId, joinedDate, lastReadEventSeq}), the user's member row and what the user may do (as get#RoomAccess). By chatRoomId, or by recordEntityName and recordId for the room bound to that record (room null, and no error, when there is none or the user may not read it: a record's Chatter asks so).

A room with the current user in it. roomTypeEnumId (or its code): CrtDirect (direct) with the other users of memberUserIdList, one room per set of users: the existing one is answered (created false) and the user is back in it; CrtPrivate or CrtPublic (roomName required) with memberUserIdList as members; CrtRecord with recordEntityName and recordId, one room per record: the existing one is answered and the user joins it if they may (a user must be able to see the record, check#RecordVisible, to make it). The maker is the owner (in a direct room every member is a member). visibilityEnumId follows the type (direct and private CrvMembers, public CrvUsers, record CrvRecord); a record room may be CrvMembers. Each member's notification level starts at CnlAll, CnlMentions in a public room. Each new member's room list hears of it on chatUser:userId.

Change a room (not a direct room): its name, topic and avatar (a moderator or owner), its visibility (CrvMembers or CrvUsers, CrvRecord for a record room), retention and archive (the owner). A change of name, topic or archive is a system event; the members' room lists hear of it on chatUser:userId.

Add users to a room, or join it. With no userId and no userIdList the current user joins a room they may join (a public room, or a record room whose record they may see). A member adds others to a room that is not direct (a direct room's members are fixed: start another direct message) and not archived; a role other than member, or an agent's agentRef, takes a moderator (owner for CmrOwner). A user who left comes back. A new member starts with everything before read. Each is a membership event; the added users' room lists hear of it on chatUser:userId.

Leave a room (userId empty or the current user), or take another member out (a moderator or owner; an owner only by an owner). Leaving a direct room hides it until its next message, with no event. When the last owner leaves a room that still has members, the longest-standing moderator, else member, becomes its owner. A membership event; the user's room list hears of it on chatUser:userId.

Give a member a role (not in a direct room): an owner gives any role, a moderator makes members and moderators of those who are not owners. A room keeps at least one owner. agentRef (a moderator) names the service an agent member's messages go to. A membership event.

The current user's own settings in a room: notificationLevelEnumId (or its code: all, mentions, none), isMuted and isPinned. A setting not given stays. The user's other tabs hear of it on chatUser:userId.

A page of a room's timeline, oldest first, for a user who may read the room (a public room's or a visible record room's without joining). By chatRoomId, or by recordEntityName and recordId for the room bound to that record (room null and an empty list, no error, when there is none or the user may not read it: Chatter asks so).
Paging by eventSeq: the latest limit events; beforeSeq for the ones before it; afterSeq for the ones after it; aroundSeq for limit events around it (a search hit, a mention). hasMoreBefore and hasMoreAfter say whether there are more. The main timeline leaves thread replies out (a thread root has threadReplyCount and threadLastDate); threadRootEventSeq gives that thread: the root and its replies. pinnedOnly gives the pinned messages, newest first.
Shown: messages, membership, pin, call, poll and system events. Edits are applied (body is the latest, edited true, editedDate), reactions are aggregated (reactions [{key, count, userIds, mine}]), a redacted message is redacted true with no body, bodyText or attachments and removedLabel "Message removed", and a reply has replyTo {eventSeq, senderUserId, senderName, snippet, redacted}. Also the room, the user's access and lastReadEventSeq, and memberList (as get#Room: each member's lastReadEventSeq gives the read markers).

A message from the current user (a member of the room, which is not archived). body is safe HTML (the m-rich-text light value: mentions are span data-mention-id); a message needs a body or attachments (chatAttachmentIdList, files the sender uploaded to this room with upload#Attachment and not yet sent). replyToEventSeq quotes a message of the room; threadRootEventSeq puts it in a thread (a reply's root is its own root). recordList [{entity, id}] names records the message is about (record cards). Mentions are counted and notified (see the file's notes); roomUrl is the notification's link. In a direct room the members who left are back. The message is indexed for search; the sender has read it; the counts of the members it counts for are published; agent members get it (deliver#AgentMessage). senderUserId sends as another user (an agent's reply), only with authorization disabled. clientRef comes back as it was, for the client to match its optimistic copy. Out: eventSeq and event (as pushed).

Change the text of one's own message (not redacted) within the edit window: the property chat_edit_window_minutes, 1440 by default, 0 for no limit. An edit event with the new body and mentions; the message keeps its place, shows the new text and is edited. New mentions are counted and notified, dropped ones no longer count. The search index has the new text.

Delete a message: one's own, or any (not in a direct room) as a moderator or owner. Its content, its edits' content and its files go, its mentions no longer count, it leaves the search index, and the timeline shows "message removed" in its place (a redaction event, content {target: 'message', reason}). A thread reply leaves its thread's count.

Toggle the current user's reaction key (an emoji, up to 32 characters) on a message: a reaction event when the user had none with that key, else that reaction is taken back (a redaction event, content {target: 'reaction', messageSeq, key}). A member of a room that is not archived.
Pin a message to the room (pinned true, the default) or unpin it: a member of a room that is not archived. A pin event (content {pinned}); nothing when it is already so.

Move the current user's read marker in a room: to eventSeq (the room's last event by default; a marker only moves forward), or with markUnread to just before eventSeq ("mark unread from here"). The user's other tabs hear of it on chatUser:userId and the room's members on chatRoom:id (read receipts); the user's counts are published.
Read everything in the current user's rooms. The user's tabs hear of it on chatUser:userId ({kind: 'read', all: true}); the user's counts are published.

actions.script: roomCount = 0 const me = ec.user.userId if (!me) return const rows = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.chat.ChatRoomMember').condition('userId', me).condition('leftDate', null).list()) if (!rows.length) return const lastOf = {} for (const room of ec.entity.find('moqui.chat.ChatRoom').condition('chatRoomId', 'in', rows.map((row) => row.chatRoomId)) .selectField('chatRoomId').selectField('lastEventSeq').list()) lastOf[room.chatRoomId] = Number(room.lastEventSeq || 0) const now = ec.user.nowTimestamp for (const row of rows) { const last = lastOf[row.chatRoomId] || 0 if (Number(row.lastReadEventSeq || 0) >= last) continue row.set('lastReadEventSeq', last) row.set('lastReadDate', now) row.update() roomCount++ } if (!roomCount) return ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.push#Signal').parameters({topic: 'chatUser:' + me, userIdList: [me], message: {kind: 'read', all: true}}).call() ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.publish#ChatCounts').parameter('userIdList', [me]).call()

service.description: A user's chat counts (the current user's; another's only with authorization disabled, as the shell counts services call it), for the shell counts' chat part: per room (roomCounts, chatRoomId to {unread, mentions, counted}) the messages from others after the read marker and the mentions among them, in the rooms the user is in that are not archived. counted is what the room adds to total: unread in a room whose level is CnlAll and that is not muted, the mentions in a room whose level is CnlMentions or that is muted, nothing at CnlNone. unread adds up the unread of the rooms that count it, mentions the mentions of the rooms that are not CnlNone, unreadRoomCount the rooms that add to total.

Tell the room's other members that the current user is typing (typing true, the default) or stopped: {kind: 'typing', chatRoomId, userId, typing} on chatRoom:id. Nothing is stored; a client shows it for a few seconds unless it is sent again.

Store a file for a message the current user is about to send in a room (a member of a room that is not archived), as dbresource://chat/(chatRoomId)/(chatAttachmentId)/(file name) (the property chat_attachment_root names another place than dbresource://chat). send#Message takes its chatAttachmentId; a file never sent goes after a day (clean#PendingAttachments).

A file of a room the current user may read, for a download transition (which sends the location): location, fileName, contentType, fileSize, chatRoomId, eventSeq. A file not yet sent only for the user who uploaded it.
Remove the chat files uploaded more than hours ago (24 by default) and never sent with a message. Each file is on its own: one that cannot be removed is logged and the rest go on.

Search the messages of the rooms the current user may read: the rooms they are in, the public rooms, and with chatRoomId one room they may read (a record room by its record). With search, the MoquiChatEvent document (filtered to those rooms: the user's rooms by id, the public ones by roomVisibilityEnumId), ranked by relevance; without search, the text of the messages (newest first). Each found message: chatRoomId, eventSeq, roomName, senderUserId, senderName, sentDate, snippet and highlight (with search).

The agent entry point (for the Assist port, mr-moqui Phase 13): hand a room message to an agent member, calling the service its agentRef names with chatRoomId, eventSeq, agentUserId, senderUserId, body, bodyText and threadRootEventSeq (the message is in the parameters, so the agent need not read it). send#Message runs it asynchronously for each agent member of the room but the sender. Without an agentRef nothing is done (logged). The agent replies with send#Message and senderUserId (authorization disabled). Failure tolerant: an error is logged.

The presence and status of users (any user's: presence is shown on every avatar), as statusMap, userId to {userId, presence, statusText, emoji, clearAtDate, inCall, lastActiveDate}. presence is offline without a heartbeat in the last 3 minutes and for an invisible user, else dnd or away as set, else away when the user has been idle for their CHAT_AUTO_AWAY_MINUTES preference (10 by default), else online. A clear-at time that has come clears the text and emoji and puts the status back to online (expire#UserStatuses writes it). With the current user among them, myStatus adds statusEnumId and status (online, away, dnd, invisible: what the user chose) and autoAwayMinutes.

Internal: publish a user's presence on the userStatus topic to the members of the rooms the user is in (and to the user's own tabs, with self true and status), when it changed since the last publish (UserStatus.lastPresence) or with force (a status text changed). Failure tolerant.

The current user's status, from the account menu: statusEnumId or status (online, away, dnd, invisible), statusText (up to 100 characters) with an emoji, and when it clears: clearAtDate, or clearAfterMinutes from now; a status not given stays, clearStatus clears the text, emoji and clear-at. Published on userStatus. Out: myStatus, as get#UserStatuses gives it.

The client's heartbeat (each minute while a page is open, and at once when the user comes back from idle): the user is connected now, and was last active idleSeconds ago (active true for now, false for not since the last beat). Presence changes are published on userStatus. Out: myStatus.

The frequent job of presence: a clear-at time that has come clears the status text and emoji and puts the status back to online; a user who was online, away or busy is published again when that changed (no heartbeat for 3 minutes is offline, idle past their auto-away minutes is away). Each user is on their own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.
